name: Report to Doren
summary: After obtaining the patrol information, Corporal Sethman directs you back to Lieutenant Doren. Delivering these findings brings crucial military intelligence directly to the rebels' commander in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: Delivering the Intelligence
sections.body: Corporal Sethman reminds you that Lieutenant Doren wants a direct report on the patrol information. You must bring what you learned back to Doren.

sections.title: A Traitor Revealed
sections.body: Presenting the patrol information reveals that Merle was the one who betrayed the camp. Lieutenant Doren mourns the loss of a soldier he once considered brave and loyal, yet feels immense relief at rooting out the traitor before Colonel Kurzen could take advantage.

faq.q: Who sends you to Lieutenant Doren?
faq.answer: Corporal Sethman sends you to report to Lieutenant Doren once you have gone over the patrol schedules with him.

aliases: what is before report to doren
faq.answer: This follows Patrol Schedules, where Corporal Sethman goes through the patrol schedules for you.
You deliver the report directly to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
